families.description: inorganic salts / simple anions (nitrate, chloride, sulfate, Tf2N-)

families.description: tetraalkylammonium cations (Aliquat 336)

families.description: organic cation (imidazolium/pyridinium, phosphonium, sulfonium) with a charge or counter-ion

families.description: R2P(=S)SH (Cyanex 301 type)

families.description: other P(=S)-OH / P-SH acids (Cyanex 302 type, thiophosphonic acids)

families.description: (RO)2P(=O)OH / ROP(=O)(OH)2, no P-C bond (D2EHPA, HDEHP, P204)
families.name: phosphoric_acid

families.description: R(RO)P(=O)OH (PC88A, P507, HEH[EHP])
families.name: phosphonic_acid_monoester

families.description: RP(=O)(OH)2
families.name: phosphonic_acid

families.description: R2P(=O)OH (Cyanex 272)
families.name: phosphinic_acid

families.description: P(=O)-C-[O,N]-C-C(=O)N (DGA analogues with one amide replaced by a phosphoryl)

families.description: (RO)3P=O (TBP)
families.name: neutral_organophosphate

families.description: R(RO)2P=O or R2(RO)P=O (DBBP)

families.description: R3P=O (TOPO, Cyanex 923)
families.name: phosphine_oxide

families.description: R-C(=O)-CH2-C(=O)-R and enol (HTTA, acetylacetone)

families.description: hydroxy-oxime chelators (LIX 84/860 type, alpha-hydroxyoximes)
families.name: hydroxyoxime

families.description: 4-acyl-5-pyrazolones, keto and enol forms (HPMBP / PMBP): beta-keto-lactam O,O chelators, acidic
families.name: acylpyrazolone

families.description: 8-hydroxyquinolines (N,O chelators, Kelex 100 type)
families.name: hydroxyquinoline

families.description: O,O chelators: alpha-hydroxy ketone on an sp2 carbon (3-hydroxyflavones such as quercetin, maltol, tropolone) or a catechol

families.description: amine N carrying two CH2-COOH arms (EDTA, DTPA, HEDTA, CDTA, NTA)
families.name: aminopolycarboxylic_acid

families.description: R-COOH (Versatic, naphthenic, 2-bromoalkanoic acids)
families.name: carboxylic_acid

families.description: N-C(=O)-C-X-C-C(=O)-N with X = ether O (incl. ring-ether THF/pyran and bis-DGA variants: TODGA, TEHDGA) or thioether S (thiodiglycolamides)
families.name: diglycolamide

families.description: N-C(=O)-C-C(=O)-N (DMDOHEMA)
families.name: malonamide

families.description: amine N carrying two CH2-C(=O)N arms (MIDOA, NTAamide, ADAAM)
families.name: amino_polyamide

families.description: aromatic N adjacent to a carboxamide/thioamide (picolinamides, pyridine-2,6-dicarboxamides, phenanthroline carboxamides)
families.name: pyridine_carboxamide

families.description: macrocyclic polyethers (ring >= 12 atoms with >= 4 O) and calixarenes (ring >= 12 atoms with >= 4 aromatic atoms and >= 3 CH2)
families.name: crown_ether_calixarene

families.description: open-chain polyether donors: two acyclic ether O separated by C-C (DOODA)
families.name: podand_ether

families.description: neutral aromatic N-donors (BTP, BTBP, BTPhen, bipyridine, phenanthroline, triazinyl/pyrazolyl/triazolyl pyridines)
families.name: n_heterocyclic

subsumes_when.note: a chelating aromatic-N pocket (>= 2 ring-N sites 3-4 bonds apart) with a carboxylic acid that cannot close a 5/6-membered chelate with any ring N: the acid is a remote substituent (EsPyTri: CH2COOH on pyridine C4 of a bis-triazolylpyridine), not the donor

families.description: >= 2 amide groups not in a DGA / malonamide / amino-polyamide / pyridine-carboxamide motif
families.name: polyamide_other

families.description: exactly one C(=O)N (DEHiBA, DHOA; the archive's 'DEHPA' is here)
families.name: monoamide

families.description: aliphatic amines (tertiary amine extractants)
families.name: amine_basic

families.description: neutral S donors: phosphine sulfides, thioamides, acyclic thioethers (a ring thioether in a saturated backbone ring, e.g. Cy5S-Me4-BTBP, does not fire)
families.name: sulfur_donor_other

families.description: alcohols without N/P/S or carbonyl (phase modifiers: 1-octanol, isodecanol)
families.name: aliphatic_alcohol

name_structure_checks.note: a diglycolAMIDE (or S-bridged thiodiglycolamide): both carbonyls must be amides, so thiodiglycolic acid under 'TDGA' fails
'DIPIC' read as dipicolinamide = pyridine-2,6-dicarboxamide (INFERRED); dipicolinic acid names are excluded
DEHPA is deliberately absent: in the monoamide literature DEHPA = N,N-di(2-ethylhexyl)propanamide, which is what the archive stores (the D2EHPA name trap)

semantics.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS is flagged when two or more fired rules remain after removing every rule listed in the 'subsumes' of another fired rule (non-nested rules)
semantics.order: rules are evaluated in list order; the label is the first fired rule not subsumed by another fired rule
semantics.overlay: an overlay rule (hydrophilic_aqueous_agent, electrolyte_salt) replaces the label; the structural label computed without overlays is kept as core_family
semantics.smarts_predicate: count of unique substructure matches on the whole molecule (all fragments) must lie in [min, max]
semantics.subsumes_when: a fired rule also subsumes the named fired rule when every predicate of the entry holds (same predicate syntax as any_of clauses); used where the chemistry of one group dominates only in a stated structural situation
